lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The flank displays approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs. The second row from the top contains the most prominent and uniformly spaced spots, showing a horizontal relative arrangement of roughly 1.5 to 2 blob diameters between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at near 90-degree angles, creating a rectilinear grid where the blobs serve as high-intensity anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible anterior portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately eight high-luminance blobs, which are smaller than the flank spots and arranged in two parallel vertical columns near the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A triangular cluster of three small, dark, circular indentations or pits is visible on the lower flank, positioned ventrally to the main white spot grid and anterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
